description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git p4 preserve users' functionality, including setting up a Perforce environment, creating users, testing commit preservation with user permissions, and handling author information during synchronization between Git and Perforce.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Defines a function to grant admin rights to a specified Perforce user.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks whether a specific user is the author of the latest change to a given Perforce file.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a change in a file attributed to a specified user by modifying the file, adding it to Git, and committing with a specific author.
